name: gap-web-search-get-query-key
about: tools.webSearch 自定义 provider 用 GET + queryApiKey 鉴权（webSearch.ts:730-760）：查询词与 api key 放在 URL 参数里（apiKeyParam 自定义），结果无 resultsPath 时整份响应当结果。另配 PILOTDECK 的 web_search 权限：缺省模式下需要询问（webSearch.ts checkPermissions），这里用 bypassPermissions。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
tools:
  webSearch:
    enabled: true
    provider: custom
    endpoint: {MOCK}/get-search?fixed=1
    apiKey: k-123
    customProvider:
      method: GET
      auth: queryApiKey
      apiKeyParam: token
